x: ULIP MANLUNG 14x2.50 (66-254) Tubeless Hybrid Tyre for EMOVE Roadrunner Tyre 14 Inch EMOVE Roadrunner EMOVE Roadrunner V2 EMOVE Roadrunner V3 Parts Roadrunner Roadrunner SE Spare Parts Tire Tubeless Tyre ULIP MANLUNG 14x2.50 (66-254) Tubeless Hybrid Tyre for EMOVE Roadrunner The ULIP MANLUNG 14x2.50 (66-254) Tubeless Hybrid Tyre combines a road-friendly centre tread with more aggressive, textured shoulder blocks to provide a versatile tyre for urban commuting and mixed-surface riding. The centre tread provides a broad, stable contact area for sealed roads, while the stippled shoulder blocks add extra mechanical grip as the scooter leans through corners and help provide additional traction on wet or uneven surfaces. Designed for tubeless installation , this tyre can also be used with a suitable inner tube where required, making it a useful replacement or upgrade option across different generations of the EMOVE RoadRunner . The tyre carries both 14x2.50 and 66-254 size markings on the sidewall. Features ULIP / MANLUNG 14-inch pneumatic tyre 14x2.50 / 66-254 size Tubeless-ready construction Can also be used with a compatible inner tube Hybrid road / light off-road tread Broad centre tread for stable road handling Deep channels for water displacement Stippled shoulder blocks for additional cornering grip Textured outer tread for mixed-surface traction Suitable for front or rear installation Ideal for commuting, paths and light gravel use Specifications Specification Details Brand ULIP / MANLUNG Tyre Size 14x2.50 ETRTO Size 66-254 Construction Pneumatic Installation Tubeless or with inner tube Tread Type Hybrid / Urban / Light Off-Road Rim Diameter 254mm nominal bead seat diameter Nominal Width 66mm Maximum Load 65kg / 143lb Maximum Pressure 250kPa / 36 PSI cold Position Front or Rear Colour Black Tread Wear Indicator TWI marked The sidewall markings visible on this tyre specify 66-254 (14x2.50) and a maximum load of 65kg at 250kPa / 36 PSI cold. Compatibility EMOVE RoadRunner Suitable for EMOVE Roadrunner models using 14x2.50 tyres . For the original Roadrunner V1 , the scooter uses a 14x2.5 outer tyre with an inner tube, so this tyre can be fitted with the appropriate tube. EcoMotion's existing V1 specification uses a 14x2.125 inner tube inside the 14x2.5 tyre. Later EMOVE Roadrunner V2, V3 and SE models use 14x2.5 tubeless tyres, making tubeless installation appropriate where the original rim and valve are configured for tubeless use. VORO MOTORS Also suitable for other electric scooters and e-bikes requiring a 14x2.50 / 66-254 tyre, subject to rim width, bead design and frame clearance. Hybrid Tread Design This tyre sits between a conventional road tyre and a heavily lugged off-road tyre. The relatively continuous centre section keeps a substantial contact patch on sealed surfaces, while the outer tread uses larger blocks and a pronounced textured finish. The stippled shoulder tread is particularly useful when the tyre is leaned during cornering, where the contact patch moves away from the smooth centre of the tyre towards the shoulder. The result is a versatile tread suited to: Urban roads Bike paths Concrete Compacted gravel Hard-packed trails Mixed commuting surfaces It is a better choice for predominantly urban use than a very aggressive knobby tyre while offering more shoulder traction than a smooth road-only pattern. Tubeless or Inner Tube Installation This tyre is designed as a tubeless tyre , but it can also be operated with a correctly sized inner tube. Tubeless installation: requires a compatible tubeless rim, suitable valve and an airtight wheel assembly. Inner tube installation: useful for compatible tube-type rims, including applications such as the original EMOVE Roadrunner V1. Using an inner tube does not change the required tyre size—the wheel must still be compatible with the tyre's 254mm bead-seat diameter . Upgrade to Armor-Dilloz BLUE Armor Dilloz (EXTREME) - Suitable for all vehicles, including speeds exceeding 48kmh/30mph - insane performance at extreme speeds. Enhanced to help with TUBE TYRES. RED Armor-Dilloz (MAXIMUM EFFECT) - Suitable for any vehicle which operates up to 48km/h (30mp/h) GREEN Armor-Dilloz (EUS & E-BIKE) - high value and large volumes applications at speeds great than 48km/h (30mp/h) Developed for the military, this is the product to use when performance counts. Now available in Australia. Armor-Dilloz incorporates an extremely high ballistic fiber load, high-tech suspension, wetting agents, an extremely high load of variable particle size rubber platelets, and significant amounts of corrosion inhibitors to protect your tyres and wheels. Rapidly seals large punctures. Rapidly seals slow leaks (leaks due to the tyre’s natural porosity, around the valve stem, etc.). Single treatment lasts the life of the tyre. Does not separate into a watery mess. Water washable. Non-flammable. Non-toxic. Tyres can still be repaired. Freeze protected. Does not react with or damage tyres. Does not react with or damage steel or aluminum wheels. Seals ~95% of punctures in the tread area of most tyres. Seals ~70% of tread area punctures on tyres with inner tubes. Even seals sidewall punctures. The Invincible Tyre Blended and bottled in the USA at the Armor-Dilloz headquarters in Miami, Florida. Using advanced sealant technology created for the military, Armor-Dilloz is the world’s most incredible tyre sealant. Incorporating a ballistic fiber web technology along with rubber platelets that vary in size, the formula creates a web of rubber filled fibers, forming a solid physical plug in the tyre which is both able to plug very large punctures & is durable enough to serve as a solution that will allow you to continue to safely and reliably operate your device, even with many punctures or extremely large punctures. Although they created this product specifically for the Onewheel, where it has been proven to seal punctures up to ½ inch in these relatively thin and delicate tyres, this product is their highest level of protection from punctures, and is suitable for all types of vehicles. This level of performance is unrivaled by any competing product. Safe and highly effective in both tube and tubeless tyres As with all sealants, the performance will typically be lower in tube type tyres, as their delicate rubber simply doesn’t allow for a lot of abuse. Note that failures on tube seams, as well as cuts/tears of the tube, such as a pinched tube, are often not sealable by any sealant including ours. A patch kit is recommended for these cases. DOSAGE INSTRUCTIONS Safety First! Always wear personal protective gear, especially eye protection. Do not eat, drink, or wear as clothing in public. Depress inner pin of valve to remove air from tyre. Remove valve core from stem, using included tool. Snip 2-3mm off of tip of Armor-Dilloz bottle (NB: start with less, then cut off more if you need. The tip needs to fit inside the valve) . Insert Armor-Dilloz bottle nozzle into valve stem, gently squeeze recommend amount (see chart) into tyre (squeeze and release repeatedly until correct amount is in tyre) Reinstall valve into stem. Inflate tyre to riding pressure. IF REPAIRING FLAT TYRE Inflate tyre to +10 PSI over your normal operating pressure (Except where this may exceed max tyre pressure rating), and then deflate tyre to riding pressure. How Much to Use?
